title: ZERO SHOTS ON TARGET AT ANFIELD FOR THE FIRST TIME IN 442 LEAGUE GAMES
description:
Best away form in the league. Only two sides with fewer home points. Liverpool, explain.

Against Arsenal, Liverpool didn't register a single shot on target. That hadn't happened in 442 league matches at Anfield. They have one win from five at home, and only Crystal Palace and Nottingham Forest have fewer home points. On the road it's the opposite: four wins and a draw. Better guests than hosts.

Now Manchester United turn up. They're 18th and winless in eight, and they haven't won at Anfield since March 2023. Shaky fortress, meet shaky visitor.
